name: ppt-improve
description: Apply report-bound, copy-on-write PPTX improvements with common-tools.

interface.shortDescription: Safely improve an audited PPTX into a new file.
interface.longDescription: Consumes a matching quality report and creates a separately re-audited PPTX only for safe automatic repairs.
defaultPrompt: Improve this audited PPTX safely and summarize the new report. Do not overwrite the source file.
